config.description: Validates the cross-space ORIGINATED_FROM topology and global node properties after a meta-learning promotion event (Phase 105).

prerequisites.description: Promote a Layer 4 concept from space 'source-repo' to 'mdemg-global' via POST /v1/memory/meta-learn.

test_cases.description: A node promoted to the global space must have an ORIGINATED_FROM edge pointing back to its local source node in a different space.
test_cases.query: MATCH (g:MemoryNode {space_id: 'mdemg-global'})-[r:ORIGINATED_FROM]->(s:MemoryNode) WHERE s.space_id <> 'mdemg-global' RETURN count(r) AS edge_count, s.space_id AS source_space

test_cases.description: Promoted global nodes must have role_type='promoted_concept', source='meta-learn', and a valid embedding.
test_cases.query: MATCH (g:MemoryNode {space_id: 'mdemg-global', source: 'meta-learn'}) RETURN g.role_type AS role_type, g.source AS source, g.embedding IS NOT NULL AS has_embedding, g.name IS NOT NULL AS has_name

test_cases.description: Global nodes must not have edges into the source space other than ORIGINATED_FROM (no accidental cross-space pollution).
test_cases.query: MATCH (g:MemoryNode {space_id: 'mdemg-global'})-[r]->(s:MemoryNode) WHERE s.space_id <> 'mdemg-global' AND type(r) <> 'ORIGINATED_FROM' RETURN count(r) AS pollution_count
